versions.heading: Versions
versions.none: {{artifact}} has no version yet; run the asset that produces it.

files.tooLarge: {{size}}: larger than the browser downloads (256 MiB). Use the command above.
files.mismatch: {{path}} did not arrive whole, so nothing was saved. Download it again, or use the command above.

delete.title: Delete version {{version}} of {{artifact}}?
delete.text: {{size}}, {{files}}. Its bytes are removed from Lakana's storage. Lakana cannot bring them back. The version stays in the list, marked deleted, and its number is never used again.
delete.keptForSweep: {{amount}} that Lakana's periodic clean-up decides about: it removes what nothing else needs and keeps the rest
